description: Bounded multi-hop walk from a start symbol. Returns the subgraph (nodes, edges, depths) reachable within the given depth and node caps. Supports forward (dependencies), reverse (dependents), and bidirectional traversal. For rules engine connections: use edge_kinds=["invoked_by"] to trace code→rules, ["governs"] for ruleset→rule structure, ["evaluates"] for rule→condition.

edge_kinds.description: Edge kinds to follow (empty = all kinds).

symbol.description: Start symbol ID for the traversal.

name: TraverseGraph
